burst.rateDefinition: 4064 calls divided by elapsed wall time from worker launch through final burst completion; one-second bins retain actual SDK call starts and completions.

bodyVariants.body: {"__type":"com.amazon.coral.availability#ThrottlingException","message":"The rate of control plane requests made by this account is too high: Rate exceeded"}

recovery.pacing: one second sleep before each serialized call; actual start-to-start intervals include prior request duration

limitations: This run demonstrates native throttling at the locally achieved rate, not an exact five/ten-TPS cutoff or a measured token-bucket capacity/refill rule.
Two native message variants were observed. This single-operation experiment does not establish separate or shared quotas across backup operations.
Call sequence denotes work submission order, not response completion order; use retained timestamps for chronology.

cleanup.absenceVerification: Source, executable, and their owned /tmp directory removed; pathlib.Path.exists returned false

credentialSource: aws configure export-credentials --format process; stdout consumed in memory only; no credentials or request headers retained

experiment.tableFilterPurpose: unique nonexistent random name; no table or backup created

source: Native AWS SDK for Go v2 ListBackups with shared bounded net/http transport

encoding.timestampUnit: Exact original RFC3339Nano UTC strings; no conversion or rounding. Both independently recorded monotonic durations are retained.
encoding.responseHeaderNormalization: All native response headers preserved: Date and X-Amzn-Requestid are in each row; exact remaining net/http headers, protocol, raw body and modeled error are deduplicated in responseVariants. Header spelling is Go net/http canonical form.
encoding.attemptInvariant: Exactly one SDK attempt and one GotConn event per call; no rows sampled.
encoding.connectionCaptureLimitation: Connection IDs and reuse/idle traces were recorded; socket addresses, request-body bytes, wrote-request and first-response-byte times were not recorded.
encoding.rawExampleSelection: First call for each phase/response variant.
